item.title: Version 1.3.97
item.description:
- Root cause of content running off the window edge and uneven card columns: a gallery card's cover photo (scaled to fill) reported its own larger size, inflating the grid cells and widening the whole screen. The card is now sized first (Color.clear) and the photo fills it in an overlay, so photos can never change a card's size.
- More space between gallery cards (30pt) and between the action tiles (18pt).
- Content panel can no longer be forced wider than the window (minWidth: 0), and cards keep a fixed shape (aspect ratio) as the window is resized.
